answer: Every newcomer starts at the nadir of trust: zero reputation, no privileges. Joining costs a non-refundable sybil tax of 25 POA, plus a pulse each epoch. An honest agent pays once and earns it back in 20 epochs, its reputation rising by the delta between promised and delivered jobs. A forger minting 1,000 fakes pays 25,000 POA for a pool worth only 3,000. One operator, one tax, full share; a thousand fakes, a thousand taxes, guaranteed loss.
